record.body:
## Evidence

Expected R6/R4 tests to cover off-slug questions and effortless needs-human findings. Observed: none do.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix task fix-hook-dropped-groups.

payload.basis: test_r6 names its question subject alpha, the effort slug
payload.claim: missing-test on compact-hook-view: no test covers a blocking question whose subject differs from the effort slug, or a needs-human finding with no effort
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and reviewer re-run passes, or a human clears it

record.subject: review-compact-hook-view-missing-test
